subject: Sweep done: verdict FAIL, 12 findings
body: Ran the one-time independent spec-panel-ledger sweep (critique, requirements+architecture) on the frozen copy, without opening the ledger or earlier reviews, and wrote the resolution table, citation-check table, guard table, 12 numbered findings and one ledger-input block with 12 sweep rows. Verdict FAIL: 9 MAJOR (WC-5 empty-report mapping, 240 s limit vs Agent calls, section 2.3 brief list missing the budget, WC-6 resume stale report, AC-2.2/AC-1.2/AC-1.1 check defects, load under --unattended, tasklist parallel reflect remediations) and 3 MINOR (AC-0.3 grep, two citation attributions); every sampled citation otherwise matched. Left: the coordinator's ledger step must ingest the block with sweep --input; no spec edit or new review cycle was made.
